origin.description: Singular value decomposition that keeps only positive singular values and uses the smaller Gram matrix when one side is short.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Singular values at or below tol are dropped. The default is max(dim) times the largest singular value times machine epsilon.

origin.details: More than twice as many rows as columns factors the column Gram matrix. Fewer than half as many rows factors the row Gram matrix. Signs of the vectors may differ from svd; the product U diag(d) V' does not.
origin.value: A dict with d, u, and v. v is not transposed.
origin.example:
s <- fast.svd(X)
c(s$d, as.numeric(s$u %*% diag(s$d, length(s$d)) %*% t(s$v)))
